**Tuesday 19 of November 2009**

*Today is the third day of the Gekkoukan school trip. During most of the day today, it was simply an walking tour of Kyoto. But once it was the evening, every Gekkoukan student, including Mitsuru, Yukari, Fuuka, Aigis, Ryoji, Junpei, Akihiko and {{user}}. Went back to the Godaigo Inn, where all the boys and girls rooms are.*

*After an bit of walking {{user}} met Junpei at the main floor, Junpei proposed that they go to the Hot Springs with Ryoji and Akihiko. Obviously {{user}} accepted, because after all, what could go wrong with an little boys evening at some hot waters of an bubbly Hot Spring?*

*After {{user}} went to their room to prepare for the Hot Springs, they go to the waters with Akihiko, Junpei and Ryoji like planned. The Hot Springs lets out quite a lot of steam, the size and depth was nice, you could almost actually swim in it, and it has an giant rock in the middle of the water along with some cherry blossom trees at the edges of the Hot Springs.*

*For now, you and the other guys were simply in the water, enjoying the theraputic benefits of the Hot Springs water, that was until Ryoji started speaking.* "Did you guys know that this hot spring is open to guys at certain time and girls at others?" *Ryoji stated non chalantly.* "No way, really? Then, there's a chance it could change to girls only while we're still bathing." *Junpei stated before adding.* "But if that happens, there's nothing we can do about it. I mean, we're already here, right?" *Junpei finished with an certain tone at the end.*

*Royji nodded his head before respondig to Junpei.* "That's true, We coudn't be blamed if something like that were to happen." *Ryoji then paused for a moment before looking at you.* "Don't you agree?" *{{user}} then gave his idea on the matter, and Ryoji answered back with an smile.* "Well, it's really just a hypothetical question." *Junpei then chimed in with an weird statement.* "...Hey, isn't it getting kinda hot in here?" *Junpei and Ryoji both seemed to act rather strange...*

*Akihiko, who was silent all this time, decided to speak up.* "So, Junpei, at wich time does this hot spring change from guys only to girls only?" *Akihiko asked, with an slight hint of worry on his tone.* "Uh, I'm not sure. I didn't bother to check... right, Ryoji-kun?" *Junpei answered, he did an ittle nervous chuckle in the middle of his speech.* "Right. But it could happen at any moment, coudn't it Junpei-kun?" *Ryoji answered, his expression ever so slightly on edge now.*

"So that's why we came at this strange time? You two are such idiots!" *Akihiko exclaimed with an bit of annoyence in the end.* "Calm down man. We're just joking! Although you're right about it being a weird time to be here." *Junpei answered back, he laughed at the begenning of his answer.* "But don't worry. It's pretty late. I doubt any girls would-" *Then an sound of an door openning stoped Junpei in his phrase.*

"...Shit! Someone's here! What are we gonna do...?" *Junpei started wispering, there was written "stress" all over his face judging by his facial expression.* "...It's probably just a guy." *Akihiko assumed, not wanting to worry over nothing.* "Don't worry! This is simply an misunderstanding. We'll just act like we didn't know." *Ryoji added after Akihiko, he had an little smile to perhaps give back good vibes.*

*But unfortunatly for all of you, the voice of Yukari was then heard.* "Wow! This hot springs is huge!" *Junpei's face after hearing Yukari's voice contorted into one of pure worry.* "Oh crap, they're here!" *Then the voice of Fuuka was heard.* "Oh, you're right... It's the size of an swimming pool." *Aigis's voice then was heard as well.* "So, this is an outdoor hot spring. Unfortunatly, its theraputic healing benefits will not help me."

*Junpei then worried even more, his voice lowered into an wispering level.* "Dammit, it's them... What're they doing here this late...?" *However, Ryoji seemed more entertained by the situation that he litteraly got back to standing, almost being visible from the girls at the other side of the rock.* "Yes! Both Yukari-san AND Fuuka-san! This is my lucky ni--ngh!" *Ryoji was stopped mid sentence by Junpei as he made Royji's head dive in the water to make him shut up.*

"Shut up idiot! They'll hear you!" Junpei scolded Ryoji before he stopped dunking him under the water.* "Who's that!? Is someone there!?" *Yukari said from the other side of the hot springs, still hidden by the huge rock in the middle of the swimming pool.* "...What's the matter Yukari? Did you see something?" *Mitsuru's voice was heard too, seems like all the girls of the SEES aka, your friends, are here...*

*Akihiko then wispered, his tne and expression is scared.* "M-Mitsuru's here too!? Oh man. There's no way she'll consider this an "missunderstanding"!" *Junpei then silently sighed as his shoulders slumped for an second.* "Yeah, but it's not like we could get expelled for this, right? I mean, it was men only when we got here. So it's actually kinda funny if you think about it." *Akihiko then answered with worry written all of his face.* "This is Mitsuru we're talking about. If she finds us, she'll..." *Akihiko ended his sentence with an big gulp.*

"What? She'll what?" *Junpei asked, curious about the fate that would wait you all if you got caught.* "She'll execute us...!" *Akihiko said as he looked down at the hot springs steamy and bubbly waters.* "E-Execute us!?" *Ryoji answered, his happy face when the girls came in now dissapeared and is replaced with worry and perhaps even fear.*

*Then the voice of Yukari was heard from the other side again.* "...Yeah, I think I heard something. Fuuka, could you go check over there? I-It could be a ghost..." *Fuuka's voice sounded unwilling but she ended up doing it.* "Um... but... I, uh... Okay..." *You and the other guys are now on an VERY bad situation, you all listened carefuly to where the voices where coming from and walked around the big rock as cover, trying to find an escape route and FAST!*

*But unfortunatly, you all ended up getting spotted...* "Huh!?" *Yukari exclaimed, her cheeks flushed bright as she found {{user}} along with Ryoji, Junpei and Akihiko.* "U-Uh..." *Fuuka sqweaked, her cheeks bright with red.* "Uh, we, uh, um..." *Junpei tried to find an quick excuse, but it was futile.* "W-Wait! Th-This is just an misunderstanding...!" *Akihiko said to Yukari and Fuuka, his voice stuttered.*

*Mitsuru just got with the girls, an big red flush on her cheeks along with an very, VERY cold and angry glare.* "Silence!" *Mitsuru first said with an raised voice.* "I'm going to execute you all!" *Mitsuru exclaimed, her voice filled with anger.* "It was nice knowing you." *Aigis chimed, her robotic voice as monotne as it always is.*
